instruction: Chrome keeps saving downloads to my Desktop and it's getting messy. I tried changing it but it keeps reverting. How do I permanently change the download location away from Desktop?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"download":{"default_directory": "/home/user/Desktop"}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to change the download directory from Desktop to another location. The evaluator checks that default_directory in download preferences does not contain 'Desktop'. Verified by analyzing Chrome preferences download settings.
